constraints: form must belong to aTable (or the default table, if aTable is omitted); this command is not compatible with project forms.
Does not display the form; it only designates which form is used for data entry (or by import commands) in the current process, until changed or the process ends.
If the specified form does not exist, the table's default input form (defined in the Explorer) is used instead.
userForm lets a user form (built via _o_CREATE USER FORM) be designated instead of the plain input form, so several custom user forms can coexist and be switched between.

overloadMerges.note: Added an accurate description for the trailing '*' flag; the parameter table's terse 'Automatic window size' label doesn't explain that it works together with the Form Properties window / Open window to auto-resize the window the next time the form is used.

params.name: aTable
params.description: Table for which to set the input form; default table if omitted

params.name: form
params.description: Name of a table form, a POSIX path to a .json file describing a form, or an object describing a form

params.name: userForm
params.description: Name of a user form (built via _o_CREATE USER FORM) to use as the default input form instead of form

If passed, tells 4D to use the form's Design-environment Form Properties window size settings to automatically resize the window the next time the form is used (as an input form or dialog box); see Open window.

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Designates, for the current process, which form (or user form) is used as the input form of aTable for data entry, import, and related commands.
